challenge.method: Compare the title leaf against MR93 physical page 7 and the Bulletin 47 supplement cover for the distinction between the language and documents describing it.
challenge.results: All three publications name the language ALGOL 68, while the earlier leaf identifies a draft and the later cover identifies the Revised Report. MR 101 is sufficient for the language identity claimed.

limitations: The title identifies the language and the credited report authors. It supplies no technical equivalence among documents.
